create_model_olmo_causal_lm: create an OlmoForCausalLM inference model from an OlmoConfig and optional quantization config
build_olmo_decoder_layer: build an OlmoDecoderLayer with attention and MLP blocks plus layer normalization
load_olmo_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into an OlmoForCausalLM with stacked param sharding support
run_olmo_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the Olmo model given input_ids, positions, and a forward batch
review_olmo_attention: review the OlmoAttention class that implements QKV projection, rotary embeddings, and RadixAttention
